result.instructions: Tools for Maintainly, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which maintenance tasks are still open at our sites?"; "Show every reactive task due before the end of the month."; "Who is assigned to task 1042, and who is free to take it?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Maintainly data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run maintainly_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run maintainly_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run maintainly_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. maintainly_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: maintainly_get_me
tools.title: Get my Maintainly account
tools.description: Return the signed-in user and every profile this token reaches, with each organisation's route key. Use it to find the organisation key.

tools.name: maintainly_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List maintenance tasks in the organisation, newest first. Filter with GitHub-style terms, such as status:open, type:reactive or due:<2026-12-31.

filter.description: GitHub-style filter terms, for example "status:open type:reactive". Quote values with spaces: assignee:"Jane Smith".

tools.name: maintainly_get_task
tools.title: Get a task
tools.description: Return one task in full: assignees, work logs, materials, downtimes, checklists and its work request.

tools.name: maintainly_list_task_assignment
tools.title: List who is assigned to a task
tools.description: List the users assigned to a task and the users not assigned. Use the user guids here with maintainly_assign_task.

annotations.title: List who is assigned to a task

tools.name: maintainly_list_work_requests
tools.title: List work requests
tools.description: List work requests (problems reported for an asset or location), with their status and the task raised from each. Filter with GitHub-style terms.

filter.description: GitHub-style filter terms, for example "status:open type:reactive". Quote values with spaces: assignee:"Jane Smith".

tools.name: maintainly_get_work_request
tools.title: Get a work request
tools.description: Return one work request with its description, reporter details, files and linked task.

tools.name: maintainly_assign_task
tools.title: Set a task's assignees
tools.description: Set the assignees of a task to exactly these users. Send every user who should stay assigned, because the request sets the full list. Get guids from maintainly_list_task_assignment.

user_guids.description: The guids of the users to assign.

tools.name: maintainly_add_task_comment
tools.title: Add a comment to a task
tools.description: Post a comment on a task. The comment is visible to everyone who can see the task.

annotations.title: Add a comment to a task

tools.name: maintainly_create_work_request
tools.title: Report a work request
tools.description: Create a work request that reports a problem. It starts as open and can become a task after review.

location.description: Where the problem is, as free text.

asset_guid.description: Optional guid of the asset the problem concerns.

prompts.title: Get started with Maintainly
prompts.description: What you can do with Maintainly here, with example requests to try.
